title: Affidavit of Mechanic’s Lien – Brawley Construction v. Aldridge Development
text:
STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF DALLAS

AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC’S LIEN

BEFORE ME, the undersigned notary public, personally appeared John Brawley, who after being duly sworn, deposes and states:

1. My name is John David Brawley. I am the sole proprietor of Brawley Construction Services, located at 1220 Elm Street, Dallas, Texas 75201. I am over 18 years of age and competent to make this affidavit.

2. On or about March 10, 2023, I entered into a written contract with Aldridge Development, LLC (“Owner”), through its managing member, Deborah Bryant, to perform certain construction work and supply materials for the improvement of real property described as Lot 12, Block 3, Oak Hills Addition, Dallas County, Texas (the “Property”). The contract was signed by Deborah Bryant on behalf of Aldridge Development.

3. I have fully performed all work and furnished all materials as required by said contract. The reasonable value of labor and materials furnished is $187,500.00. Despite due demand, Owner has failed and refused to pay the balance of $67,232.00.

4. I timely served a written notice of the unpaid balance on Owner by certified mail on July 15, 2023. A copy of said notice is attached as Exhibit A.

5. This affidavit is made for the purpose of perfecting a mechanic’s lien on the Property pursuant to Texas Property Code § 53.054.

6. I have read the foregoing affidavit and it is true and correct.

FURTHER AFFIANT SAYETH NOT.

_________________________________
John Brawley

SWORN TO AND SUBSCRIBED before me this 22nd day of August, 2023, by John Brawley.

_________________________________
Notary Public, State of Texas
My Commission Expires: _________ (SEAL)

BATES DOCUMENT: BRA-ALD-000001 through BRA-ALD-000045

CAUSE NO. DC-23-14567

IN THE DISTRICT COURT OF DALLAS COUNTY, TEXAS
191ST JUDICIAL DISTRICT

BRAWLEY CONSTRUCTION SERVICES, Plaintiff,
v.
ALDRIDGE DEVELOPMENT, LLC, Defendant.

CITATION: 45 S.W.3d 211 (Tex. App.—Dallas 2001) (citing Brawley v. Aldridge, 89 S.W.2d 118 (Tex. 1936)).

Statutory Reference: Texas Property Code § 53.054 (a) – “A person may file a lien affidavit not later than the 15th day of the 4th calendar month after the day the indebtedness accrues.”

Names:
- Plaintiff: John Brawley, also known as John D. Brawley, “Johnny” Brawley, Mr. Brawley.
- Defendant: Aldridge Development, LLC, represented by its manager Deborah Bryant, also known as Deb Bryant, Ms. Bryant.
- Counsel for Plaintiff: Sarah Mitchell, Bar No. 24056789, Mitchell & Associates, 1000 Main St., Dallas, TX 75201, phone: 214-555-0199, email: sarah.mitchell@mitchell-law.com.
- Judge: Hon. Michael Torres, Presiding Judge of the 191st District Court.

Additional identifiers:
- SSN of John Brawley: 468 21 9973 (written with spaces) and 468-21-9973 (with dashes).
- Date of Birth of John Brawley: November 3, 1975.
- Policy Number: INS-7743-2023 (liability insurance for Brawley Construction).
- VIN: 1HGBH41JXMN109186 (owner’s vehicle used for materials transport).
- Reporter citations: 45 S.W.3d 211 (Tex. App.—Dallas 2001); 89 S.W.2d 118 (Tex. 1936).

Dated: August 22, 2023.

title: Affidavit of Constitutional Lien – Torres Framing v. Horizon Homes
text:
STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF HARRIS

AFFIDAVIT OF CONSTITUTIONAL LIEN

BEFORE ME, the undersigned notary, personally appeared Carlos Torres, known as Carl, Mr. Torres, and formally Carlos M. Torres, who being duly sworn, states:

1. I am the owner of Torres Framing, Inc., a Texas corporation, with principal office at 456 Oak Avenue, Houston, Texas 77002. I am over 21 and competent.

2. On January 15, 2024, Torres Framing entered into a subcontract with Horizon Homes, L.P. (“Owner”), through its representative, James Miller, to provide rough framing for a residential development at 789 Pine Street, Houston, Texas 77003. The Owner is represented by counsel, Lisa Chen of Chen & Partners.

3. I have fully performed. The contract price was $320,000.00. Unpaid balance is $145,800.00.

4. On March 1, 2024, I served notice of nonpayment. A copy is attached.

5. This lien is filed under Article XVI, Section 37 of the Texas Constitution and Texas Property Code § 53.001 et seq.

6. The property is legally described as Lot 7, Block 2, Horizon Park Addition, Harris County.

7. I have read this affidavit and it is true.

_________________________________
Carlos Torres

SWORN to before me this 10th day of April, 2024.

_________________________________
Notary Public (SEAL)
